description: Before you build or ship an AI feature, check where it lands under the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689). Describe the use case (with biometric / remote-identification / automated-decision / social-scoring / GPAI flags) and VITNA returns the risk tier (prohibited / high-risk / limited-risk / minimal-risk), GPAI obligations, and the per-tier obligations you would have to meet. A classification for you to act on: VITNA evaluates and records, it does not gate the build.
name: ai_act_classify
